name: title
on_screen: How to Use Dictation on Mac — Built-In + AI
text: Here’s how to use dictation on a Mac — with Apple’s built-in option, and with AI Dictation.

name: built_in_setup
text: For built-in Dictation, open System Settings, choose Keyboard, and turn Dictation on. Pick your language, microphone, and shortcut.

name: built_in_use
on_screen: Click a text field → Start Dictation → Speak → Escape
text: Place your cursor in a text field. Press the Microphone key, your shortcut, or choose Edit, Start Dictation. Speak, then press Escape.

name: ai_shortcut
on_screen: Hold for push-to-talk · Double-tap for a longer recording
text: AI Dictation starts from a configurable global shortcut. Hold it for push-to-talk, or double-tap to start and stop a longer recording.

name: ai_control
on_screen: Local or cloud · Cleanup · Vocabulary · Rules · Shortcuts
text: You can choose local recognition when supported or cloud transcription, then add optional cleanup, personal vocabulary, replacements, writing rules, and spoken shortcuts.

name: ai_result
on_screen: Text returns to the active app
text: When processing finishes, AI Dictation returns the final text to the active app, ready where you were already writing.

name: cta
text: Start with built-in Dictation. When you need more control, try the open-source AI Dictation at aidictation dot com slash download.
